title: Second Conditional: Rules and Examples — Quiz 80A
content:
## Second Conditional: Rules and Examples

Learn to use the past simple with would and an infinitive for an unreal present or future situation.

### Lesson focus

1. If I had wings, I would fly to you.
2. If I were you, I would not do that.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
